features.statement: Page uses a dual type system pairing a system sans stack with Georgia-style serif, split roughly evenly across elements.
Body text is mid-size (about 17px) with generous line height around 1.55.
Featured headline is large bold serif-scale (30px), while section label headings render much smaller, creating a strong size contrast.
Dates and metadata appear as small uppercase letter-spaced grey sans text above headlines.
Hierarchy is carried by weight, case and size alone: bold headlines, uppercase labels, grey metadata, with no badges or decorative icons.
Palette is built on deep green with a mid-green accent button, plus near-black green-tinted text on pure white.
Sections alternate between white and a very light grey-green tinted background.
A single saturated accent in the hero photo, such as red, stands out against an otherwise green and grey palette.
Header is a full-width dark bar with logo left, search and call-to-action beside it, and bold white nav links right.
Content sits in a centered fixed-width column, with the hero breaking out to bleed to the page edge.
Hero pairs a full-bleed left photo with a grey text panel holding date, headline and read-more link.
News is shown as a three-column row of text-only cards with date and headline, no thumbnails.
Media section pairs one large video thumbnail with a stacked list of smaller titled cards beside it.
Secondary sections such as events and social feed sit side by side in two columns.
Each section heading has a dark horizontal rule beneath it, with a right-aligned 'All … →' link on the label line.
Section links are small, bold, underlined and end with a right-arrow character.
Feed items are separated by thin light grey hairline dividers with relative timestamps.
Read-more links are bold dark green text with a green underline accent bar.
Partner logos are shown in a row with descriptive alt text naming each organization.
Footer has a text link on the left and a row of small icon-plus-label social links on the right.
Video thumbnail is a static image with player controls and title baked into the picture, with empty alt text.
Page uses no shadows, blur, transitions, animations or transforms, giving a flat static look.
Page is lightweight: no scripts, external stylesheets or SVGs, with a single inline style block.
Copy is sparse and terse, mostly headlines and labels, with no emoji, exclamation marks or em dashes.
Page uses semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, section, article, footer) but lacks an h1 and has minimal meta and no structured data.
Sparse metadata: only charset and viewport meta tags, a short title, and no JSON-LD.
Interactions are mostly plain links rather than buttons; call-to-action items are rendered as anchors.
